name: Amano Satoko
source: The president of the Occult and Mysticism Research Club, one year senior to Takeru and Shiori. She is especially admired by Shiori, who belongs to the same club. She appears to be quite well-educated, with a gentle and calm personality, guiding Takeru and the others with mysterious power.
